records.source: Hmmph... It's irritating to have to meet all these new people, huh?#$b#Name's George, by the way. Now buzz off... Hmmph.
records.translation: Hmph... Nakakainis na kailangan kong makilala ang lahat ng bagong taong ito, ano?#$b#George ang pangalan ko. Ngayon, lumayas ka na... Hmph.

records.source: Hmm... *sip*... ahhh... Tastes just like Mama's tuna casserole! Delicious!
records.translation: Hmm... *higop*... ahhh... Lasang-lasang kaserol ng tuna ni Mama! Masarap!

records.source: What's this?#$b#Hmmph... so you push this button first? What's this button do? Hmmph... *grumble*#$b#Hehe! Well, how about that! It's a new channel!$h#$b#Here, take this. It's a stone I found when I was a coal miner back in the day. Funny thing, it's glowed blue and stayed cold for over forty years. Like magic!
records.translation: Ano ito?#$b#Hmph... kaya pipindutin muna ang buton na ito? Ano ang ginagawa ng butong ito? Hmph... *bulung-bulong*#$b#Hehe! Aba, tingnan mo nga naman! Bagong channel!$h#$b#Heto, kunin mo ito. Nahanap ko ang batong ito noong minero pa ako ng karbon. Kakatwa, mahigit apatnapung taon na itong kumikinang nang asul at nananatiling malamig. Parang mahika!

records.source: There, there, honey... Don't you worry.%noturn#$b#Even if it is poisonous, I breathed in more noxious gas in one minute back in the ol' coal mines... And I'm still kickin'!
records.translation: Sige na, mahal... Huwag kang mag-alala.%noturn#$b#Kahit nakalalason ito, mas maraming nakalalasong gas ang nalanghap ko sa loob ng isang minuto sa mga lumang minahan ng karbon... At buhay pa rin ako!

records.source: Looks like the young folks will have to do some extra weeding after this one...Heheh...$h
records.translation: Mukhang kailangang magbunot ng dagdag na damo ang mga kabataan pagkatapos nito... Heheh...$h

records.source: Thanks for replacing that beat up old trailer... the new house is much nicer to look at.#$e#You know, I'll bet it increases the value of our property too!
records.translation: Salamat sa pagpapalit sa luma at sira-sirang trailer... Mas magandang tingnan ang bagong bahay.#$e#Alam mo, tiyak kong pinatataas din nito ang halaga ng ari-arian natin!

records.source: Welp... that new house blocks my view of the river a little... but it sure looks nicer than that old tin can Pam was livin' in.
records.translation: Aba... Medyo hinaharangan ng bagong bahay na iyon ang tanaw ko sa ilog... pero mas maganda naman iyon kaysa lumang latang tinitirhan ni Pam.

records.source: You wanna see a movie with an old geezer like me? ...Well... okay. I'll meet you there.
records.translation: Gusto mong manood ng pelikula kasama ang matandang hukluban na tulad ko? ...Aba... sige. Magkita tayo roon.

records.source: I dunno what you did, but those raccoons haven't been back since last week!
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung ano ang ginawa mo, pero hindi na bumalik ang mga rakun mula noong nakaraang linggo!

records.source: I may seem out of touch, but when you've been around for as long as I have, you learn a thing or two about the ways of life. It's called 'wisdom'.#$b#Young people don't understand the big picture. How could they?
records.translation: Maaaring mukha akong lipas sa panahon, pero kapag nabuhay ka nang kasintagal ko, may matututuhan ka tungkol sa takbo ng buhay. “Karunungan” ang tawag doon.#$b#Hindi nauunawaan ng mga kabataan ang kabuuang larawan. Paano nila mauunawaan?

records.source: ...Hmmph.^I'd like to become a great-grandpa before I croak. Think you can make that happen?
records.translation: ...Hmph.^Gusto kong maging lolo sa tuhod bago ako mamatay. Magagawa mo ba iyon?

records.source: Hmmph... took the easy way out, huh?#$e#People these days treat marriage like a television set... If you get bored, just change the channel! Back in my day... *grumble*
records.translation: Hmph... pinili mo ang madaling paraan, ano?#$e#Para lang telebisyon ang pag-aasawa sa mga tao ngayon... Kapag nagsawa ka, magpalit ka lang ng channel! Noong panahon ko... *bulung-bulong*

records.source: So... the old Community Center is gone, huh? Whatever happened to small-town values? It's a shame how times have changed...
records.translation: Kaya... wala na ang lumang Sentro ng Komunidad, ano? Ano na ang nangyari sa mga pagpapahalaga ng munting bayan? Nakalulungkot ang pagbabago ng panahon...

records.source: I'm not much of a talker. Especially not to strangers, if you don't mind me saying.
records.translation: Hindi ako masalita. Lalo na sa mga estranghero, kung hindi mo mamasamain.

records.source: Hmmph... Looks like another gloomy day.$s
records.translation: Hmph... Mukhang isa na namang mapanglaw na araw.$s

records.source: Alex is my grandson. Have I told you that already?#$e#Huh? Speak up.
records.translation: Apo kong lalaki si Alex. Nasabi ko na ba iyon sa iyo?#$e#Ha? Lakasan mo ang pagsasalita.

records.source: How can two men get married? It's unnatural... Hmmph. I guess I'm just "old fashioned"...^You're part of the family, now. I'm glad that my grandson found such a nice wife.
records.translation: Paano makapag-aasawa ang dalawang lalaki? Hindi iyon likas... Hmph. Marahil “makaluma” lang ako...^Bahagi ka na ng pamilya. Natutuwa akong nakahanap ng napakabait na asawa ang apo ko.

records.source: I'll admit, I thought it was... strange... for two men to be together. But you're such a nice young man, and I know you two are in love... I've changed my mind.^You're part of the family, now... and I couldn't be more proud.
records.translation: Aaminin ko, inakala kong... kakaiba... ang magsama ang dalawang lalaki. Pero napakabait mong binata, at alam kong nagmamahalan kayong dalawa... Nagbago na ang isip ko.^Bahagi ka na ng pamilya... at labis kitang ipinagmamalaki.

records.source: I can't talk right now, young man.^I can't talk right now, miss.#$e#My favorite program is on.
records.translation: Hindi ako puwedeng makipag-usap ngayon, binata.^Hindi ako makapagsalita ngayon, dalaga.#$e#Ipinapalabas ang paborito kong programa.

records.source: So you're a farmer, huh? At least it's honest work.
records.translation: Kaya magsasaka ka, ano? Marangal na trabaho naman iyon.

records.source: The weekend is no different than any other time, for me.#$e#That's how it is when you're retired.
records.translation: Walang ipinagkaiba sa akin ang katapusan ng linggo sa ibang panahon.#$e#Ganoon kapag retirado ka na.

records.source: Aren't you cold? They don't make sweaters like they used to.#$e#*Sigh*
records.translation: Hindi ka ba nilalamig? Hindi na sila gumagawa ng mga sweater gaya noong araw.#$e#*Buntong-hininga*

records.source: I'm surprised you want to be friends with an old-timer like me.
records.translation: Nagulat akong gusto mong makipagkaibigan sa isang matandang tulad ko.

records.source: Hello, @. Wanna watch the TV with me?
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Gusto mong manood ng telebisyon kasama ko?

records.source: My grand-pap was a farmer. It's a respectable profession.#$e#If I wasn't so darned old I'd come to your farm and show you a thing or two...
records.translation: Magsasaka ang lolo ko. Kagalang-galang na propesyon iyon.#$e#Kung hindi lang ako napakatanda, pupunta ako sa bukid mo at tuturuan kita ng ilang bagay...

records.source: I wish my legs worked so I could play catch with Alex.$s#$e#That'll never happen.$s
records.translation: Sana gumagana ang mga binti ko para makapaglaro kami ni Alex ng saluhan.$s#$e#Hindi iyon kailanman mangyayari.$s

records.source: I've been thinking...Maybe I've been a little bit of a grouch.$s#$e#I used to think no one cared about us old folks.
records.translation: Nag-iisip ako... Baka medyo naging masungit ako.$s#$e#Akala ko noon ay walang nagmamalasakit sa aming matatanda.

records.source: You know, I really have been a grumpy old man to everyone. But now I feel like I'm softening up like an old ripe fruit. Hehe!$h#$e#Take care, son.^Take care, hun.
records.translation: Alam mo, talagang naging masungit akong matanda sa lahat. Pero pakiramdam ko ay lumalambot na ako tulad ng matandang hinog na prutas. Hehe!$h#$e#Mag-ingat ka, anak.^Mag-ingat ka, mahal.

records.source: @! Let me turn off this darned television and we can have a little chat.$h#$e#So what are the young people doing these days?
records.translation: @! Patayin ko muna itong lintik na telebisyon at mag-usap tayo nang kaunti.$h#$e#Ano ang ginagawa ng mga kabataan ngayon?

records.source: You know, I shouldn't get too depressed about my legs.#$e#I should just be happy that I'm alive.$h
records.translation: Alam mo, hindi ako dapat masyadong malungkot tungkol sa mga binti ko.#$e#Dapat masaya na lang akong buhay ako.$h

records.source: When you get as old as me it's a lot harder to adjust to new things.#$e#One day you'll know what I mean.#$e#Go on, enjoy yourself while you're still young.
records.translation: Kapag kasingtanda mo na ako, mas mahirap nang umangkop sa mga bagong bagay.#$e#Balang araw, mauunawaan mo ang ibig kong sabihin.#$e#Sige, magsaya ka habang bata ka pa.

records.source: Ohh... It's so cold.#$e#When you're young the cold doesn't bite as hard.
records.translation: Ohh... Napakalamig.#$e#Kapag bata ka, hindi gaanong matindi ang kagat ng lamig.

records.source: You don't like it, huh? Bah! Kids these days... no appreciation for anything. That was expensive, and I'm not made of money, you know!
records.translation: Hindi mo gusto, ano? Bah! Mga bata ngayon... walang pinahahalagahan. Mahal iyon, at hindi ako nagluluwa ng pera, alam mo!

records.source: Hello, farmer.#$e#I've been gone so long... I feel like a stranger.
records.translation: Kumusta, magsasaka.#$e#Napakatagal kong nawala... Pakiramdam ko ay estranghero ako.

records.source: For me? Well, that's unexpected... But I won't say no. Thanks!
records.translation: Para sa akin? Aba, hindi ko inaasahan iyon... Pero hindi ako tatanggi. Salamat!

records.source: Well, I can't read Dwarvish, but it's an interesting collector's item. Thank you.
records.translation: Aba, hindi ako marunong bumasa ng wikang Duwende, pero kawili-wiling bagay ito para sa koleksiyon. Salamat.

records.source: Heh... The rain is a blessing. A reminder that there will always be forces greater than anything conceived of by man.#$e#That's actually a comfort, @.
records.translation: Heh... Pagpapala ang ulan. Paalala itong palaging may mga puwersang higit sa anumang kayang isipin ng tao.#$e#Sa totoo lang, nakaaaliw iyon, @.

records.source: Hey, @. Nice to see you.
records.translation: Uy, @. Masayang makita ka.

records.source: Time to head home.
records.translation: Oras nang umuwi.

records.source: Standing on this beach... I feel a rare sense of peace.$h#$e#The ocean is a very special thing.
records.translation: Habang nakatayo ako sa dalampasigang ito... nakararamdam ako ng bihirang kapayapaan.$h#$e#Lubhang natatangi ang karagatan.

records.source: This is a great place to bond with the family. I really appreciate you fixing it up.
records.translation: Napakagandang lugar nito upang mapalapit sa pamilya. Lubos kong pinahahalagahan ang pag-aayos mo rito.

records.source: Just getting some water.
records.translation: Kumukuha lang ako ng tubig.

records.source: It makes a father proud to see his boy become a man. You have my heartfelt blessing.$h
records.translation: Ipinagmamalaki ng isang ama na makitang naging ganap na lalaki ang anak niya. Buong puso ang basbas ko sa inyo.$h

records.source: The boat ride was fun. I even got to use some of my nautical training to help navigate.$h
records.translation: Masaya ang pagsakay sa bangka. Nagamit ko pa ang ilan sa pagsasanay ko sa paglalayag upang tumulong sa paglalayag.$h

records.source: My apologies for the other day.#$e#I don't want any special treatment. I just want to be a normal person, like everyone else.
records.translation: Humihingi ako ng paumanhin sa nangyari noong isang araw.#$e#Ayaw ko ng natatanging pagtrato. Gusto ko lang maging karaniwang tao, gaya ng lahat.

records.source: Erm... okay. Thank you. I'll meet you there.$h
records.translation: Ah... sige. Salamat. Magkita tayo roon.$h

records.source: ...!$4#$b#...Where did you find this?$4#$b#...$5#$b#This man... We fought together in the war, @. He was like a brother to me. #$b#But... only one of us made it back.$5#$b#He never lost his courage, though. Even in the face of death. A true hero... I'll never forget him.#$b#Thanks for bringing me this... It means a lot to me.#$b#Here, take this. It's been sitting in the back of our cupboard for years, and we've never used it.
records.translation: ...!$4#$b#...Saan mo ito nahanap?$4#$b#...$5#$b#Ang lalaking ito... Magkasama kaming nakipaglaban sa digmaan, @. Para ko siyang kapatid.#$b#Pero... isa lamang sa amin ang nakabalik.$5#$b#Hindi niya kailanman nawala ang tapang niya. Kahit sa harap ng kamatayan. Isang tunay na bayani... Hindi ko siya malilimutan.#$b#Salamat sa pagdala nito sa akin... Napakahalaga nito sa akin.#$b#Heto, kunin mo ito. Ilang taon na itong nakatago sa likod ng aparador namin at hindi namin kailanman nagamit.

records.source: Yep... It's been tightly sealed, so the flavor should still be really potent.
records.translation: Oo... Mahigpit itong nakasara, kaya dapat napakatapang pa rin ng lasa.

records.source: I don't know if I'll ever get used to being back home.#$e#The peacefulness of the town feels like a mask. That's probably just me though.
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung masasanay pa ako sa pagbabalik sa tahanan.#$e#Parang maskara ang katahimikan ng bayan. Pero baka ako lang iyon.

records.source: Things haven't changed much since I've been gone.#$e#Well, except that you're here.
records.translation: Walang gaanong nagbago mula nang umalis ako.#$e#Maliban sa narito ka na.

records.source: Things haven't changed much since I've been gone.#$e#Except that we have a new farmer in town.$h
records.translation: Walang gaanong nagbago mula nang umalis ako.#$e#Maliban sa may bago tayong magsasaka sa bayan.$h

records.source: I feel like I'm settling back in pretty well. It's nice to have a friend in town.$h
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay maayos na akong nakababalik sa dating buhay. Masarap magkaroon ng kaibigan sa bayan.$h

records.source: ...I lost a lot of friends in battle.$s#$e#What's sad is that I can't even remember their faces.#$e#...
records.translation: ...Marami akong kaibigang nawala sa labanan.$s#$e#Ang nakalulungkot ay hindi ko na maalala maging ang mga mukha nila.#$e#...

records.source: You've been here a while now, haven't you? Your farm must be thriving.
records.translation: Matagal ka na rito, hindi ba? Tiyak na maunlad ang bukid mo.

records.source: To be alive is a special gift, and it comes and goes in the blink of an eye... never lose sight of that.
records.translation: Natatanging regalo ang mabuhay, at dumarating at nawawala iyon sa isang kisap-mata... huwag mong kalilimutan iyon.

records.source: #$1 Kent1#I've been up since 4 o'clock... sometimes I wonder if I'll ever get back into a normal routine.$k#$e#Sam has really grown up since I left. He's a man now.#$e#I wish I could've been there for him.$s
records.translation: #$1 Kent1#Gising na ako mula pa alas-kuwatro... Minsan ay iniisip ko kung makababalik pa ako sa karaniwang gawain.$k#$e#Talagang malaki na si Sam mula nang umalis ako. Ganap na siyang lalaki.#$e#Sana naroon ako para sa kaniya.$s

records.source: Are you friends with my son?#$e#You probably know him better than I do...$s
records.translation: Kaibigan mo ba ang anak kong lalaki?#$e#Malamang mas kilala mo siya kaysa sa akin...$s

records.source: Hey, @. Are you enjoying the married lifestyle?
records.translation: Uy, @. Nasisiyahan ka ba sa buhay-may-asawa?

records.source: It looks like a decent day for fishing, doesn't it?
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para mangisda, hindi ba?

records.source: I oughta take up fishing. It would give me something to do, keep my hands busy.
records.translation: Dapat siguro akong magsimulang mangisda. Magkakaroon ako ng gagawin at magiging abala ang mga kamay ko.

records.source: Jodi tells me you've really become a part of this community. I'm glad to hear it.
records.translation: Sabi ni Jodi, talagang naging bahagi ka na ng komunidad na ito. Natutuwa akong marinig iyon.

records.source: I have trouble sleeping, so please excuse me if I seem tired.#$e#I'm sure you can understand.
records.translation: Nahihirapan akong matulog, kaya pagpasensiyahan mo kung mukha akong pagod.#$e#Tiyak kong nauunawaan mo.

records.source: I don't know what to do with myself now that I'm back.#$e#I'm used to having more structure in my day.
records.translation: Hindi ko alam ang gagawin sa sarili ko ngayong nakabalik na ako.#$e#Nasanay akong mas organisado ang araw ko.

records.source: You've got a routine to keep you busy, huh? That's a good thing.#$e#Too much freedom can be stifling. We all benefit from having some structure in our lives.
records.translation: May nakagawian kang nagpapanatiling abala sa iyo, ano? Mabuting bagay iyon.#$e#Maaaring makasakal ang sobrang kalayaan. Nakikinabang tayong lahat sa kaunting kaayusan sa buhay.

records.source: You keep quiet! Stop trying to turn me against my wife.$u
records.translation: Tumahimik ka! Huwag mo akong subukang pag-awayin sa asawa ko.$u

records.source: ...$s#$b#You're absolutely right, @.$s
records.translation: ...$s#$b#Tamang-tama ka, @.$s

records.source: Don't lie to me! I hate lies more than anything!$u
records.translation: Huwag kang magsinungaling sa akin! Higit sa lahat, galit ako sa mga kasinungalingan!$u
